sources.title: onnxruntime-genai/examples/csharp/NemotronSpeech at main · microsoft ...
sources.snippet: This example demonstrates real-time streaming speech recognition using the NVIDIA Nemotron Speech Streaming model with the ONNX Runtime GenAI C# API. Audio is streamed through the model in chunks (simulating a microphone feed), and transcribed text is printed incrementally as it becomes available.

sources.title: Pushing the Limits of On-Device Streaming ASR:
sources.snippet: Based on our evaluation, we selected the Nemotron-0.6B int4 k-quant variant with the (7, 10, 7) streaming configuration and 0.56 s algorithmic delay as our recommended on-device streaming ASR model.

sources.title: Pushing the Limits of On-Device Streaming ASR: A Compact, High-Accuracy ...
sources.snippet: Having identified Nemotron-0.6B with the configuration as our base model, we built a complete end-to-end streaming inference pipeline and applied ONNX Runtime quantization to optimize it for CPU-only edge deployment.
